tasks.label: Build and export Docker images
args: $pom = [xml](Get-Content -Raw 'pom.xml'); $versionNode = $pom.SelectSingleNode('/*[local-name()="project"]/*[local-name()="version"]'); if ($null -eq $versionNode) { throw 'Could not find the project version in pom.xml' }; $version = $versionNode.InnerText; docker compose -f compose.yaml build; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; docker compose -f compose.yaml pull cloudflared; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; docker image save --output "cyanidebowl-$version.tar" cyanidebowl-frontend:latest cyanidebowl-backend:latest cyanidebowl-pybb3-service:latest cloudflare/cloudflared:latest; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }

tasks.label: Build and export Docker images (Raspberry Pi)
args: $pom = [xml](Get-Content -Raw 'pom.xml'); $versionNode = $pom.SelectSingleNode('/*[local-name()="project"]/*[local-name()="version"]'); if ($null -eq $versionNode) { throw 'Could not find the project version in pom.xml' }; $version = $versionNode.InnerText; docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.rpi.yaml build; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.rpi.yaml pull cloudflared; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; docker image save --output "cyanidebowl-$version-rpi.tar" cyanidebowl-frontend:arm64 cyanidebowl-backend:arm64 cyanidebowl-pybb3:arm64 cloudflare/cloudflared:latest; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
